_doc: Example configuration for the ISO builder. The watcher reads these values from config.json next to build-status.json.
_ready: Set to true to trigger a build. The watcher resets this to false when it starts the job.
_dest_device: Required block device for unattended installation.
_auto_rebuild_on_fcos_update: Set to true to rebuild automatically when a newer FCOS ISO is detected.
